planted.item: The board authorises management to negotiate the Harrowgate renewal with a liability cap of at least four hundred thousand dollars.
The board resolved to appoint Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer with effect from 1 June 2026.
The board approved a budget of two point four million kronor for Project Lantern.
The board resolved not to propose an interim dividend and will revisit the matter at the September meeting.
Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
Sofia Berg will prepare Maria Ek's service agreement for signature by the end of May.
Petra Voss will draft a short note to shareholders explaining the decision before the end of June.
Sofia Berg expresses concern about the steep fee increase for a two-year term.
The ownership of the data produced by Project Lantern remains unresolved and requires legal advice.

sources.quote: Four of the six directors are present, so the meeting is quorate.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

sources.quote: I declare an interest in the Northbridge project because a family member works there.
sources.speaker: Anders Holm

items.text: Anders Holm declares an interest in the Northbridge project due to a family member working there.

sources.quote: You will not take part in item four.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: Anders Holm will not take part in item four.

sources.quote: Harrowgate has sent its redline of the Master Services Agreement. The fee rises to nineteen thousand seven hundred and fifty dollars a month.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Harrowgate has sent a redline of the Master Services Agreement with a fee increase to nineteen thousand seven hundred and fifty dollars a month.

sources.quote: They also offer a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Harrowgate offers a liability cap of five hundred thousand dollars, up from two hundred and fifty thousand.

sources.quote: I am comfortable with the cap but the fee increase is steep for a two year term.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Sofia Berg expresses concern about the steep fee increase for a two-year term.

sources.quote: Could we ask for a three year term at the current fee instead?
sources.speaker: Erik Nyström

items.text: Erik Nyström suggests asking for a three-year term at the current fee instead.

sources.quote: We can ask, but they have not indicated any flexibility on the fee so far.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss states that the fee is not flexible as of now.

sources.quote: the board authorises management to negotiate the renewal, provided the liability cap is not reduced below four hundred thousand dollars
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The board authorises management to negotiate the Harrowgate renewal with a liability cap of at least four hundred thousand dollars.

sources.quote: All in favour? That is carried unanimously.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist

items.text: The motion to authorise negotiation of the Harrowgate renewal is carried unanimously.

sources.quote: I will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.
sources.speaker: Petra Voss

items.text: Petra Voss will send the board's position to Harrowgate by Friday.

sources.quote: Whether we accept the fee increase at all is still open; we should come back to it once we see their answer.
sources.speaker: Sofia Berg

items.text: Whether to accept the fee increase for Harrowgate is still open.

sources.quote: The nominations committee recommends Maria Ek as Chief Financial Officer from the first of June.
sources.speaker: Karin Lindqvist
